rationale: Retry-After is not a CORS-safelisted response header. The Worker sets the header but does not expose it, so cross-origin headers.get returns null and the client defaults to its short exponential backoff. This matches the actual isolated browser observation of a second POST before10seconds. Server rate limiting remains enforced and retry count bounded; this is a required transport fix rather than independently judged major privacy/game/save risk.
